purpose: Validate a paper-like one-sentence author-compatible orchestration before the full Figure-3 sweep: use a long deterministic uniform bitstream, embed continuously, and stop at the first sentence boundary selected by the pinned reference predicate.

secret_stream.rule: The stream is a finite implementation of an effectively long uniform random message. The run must stop at the first sentence boundary before the stream is exhausted; exhaustion is a hard failure, never silently zero-padded.

sentence_stop.predicate_semantics: A generated token is sentence-final when its decoded token text contains '.', '!', or '?'. This is the only public sentence-finish predicate in the pinned author repository; the unavailable Figure-3 batch driver may have used additional orchestration that cannot be recovered from the public code.
sentence_stop.max_token_policy: Safety cap only. Hitting the cap is a hard pilot failure and does not silently truncate a Figure-3 sample.

parity_sentinel.rule: Before trusting first-boundary stopping, the repository-owned mirrors must reproduce the pinned fixed-message encoders with finish_sent=false. Parity is checked for Bins, Huffman, and both Arithmetic pilot points.

payload_accounting.payload_bits: Bits confirmed as encoded by the author algorithm when the first sentence boundary token has been emitted.
payload_accounting.secret_bits_read: For Bins/Huffman this equals consumed bits. For Arithmetic it includes the precision-bit look-ahead required to select tokens and can exceed confirmed payload_bits.
payload_accounting.arithmetic_zero_padding: Forbidden in the paper-sentence measurement path. A full precision-bit look-ahead must be available at every Arithmetic step.
payload_accounting.decoder_check: The author decoder applied to transported text must recover a prefix equal to all confirmed payload bits. Arithmetic may emit additional final-flush bits after that prefix.

success_criteria: all four mirror parity sentinels pass against the pinned executable reference
all 32 paper-sentence pilot runs stop on their first author sentence-boundary token
no run exhausts the long secret stream or hits the 256-token safety cap
all runs confirm at least one payload bit
the author decoder recovers every confirmed payload prefix from ordinary text transport
Arithmetic uses no implicit zero look-ahead in the paper-sentence measurement path
the pinned Harvard checkout remains byte-for-byte unmodified
scope_note: This pilot freezes the Stage-3 operationalization of the paper phrase 'generate an entire sentence given a uniform random message'. It does not claim that the unavailable original Figure-3 batch driver used the exact same stopping code.
